scripts.dev: pnpm --dir packages/shared build && pnpm --dir packages/game-engine build && pnpm --dir apps/web dev
scripts.build: pnpm --dir packages/shared build && pnpm --dir packages/game-engine build && pnpm --dir apps/web build
scripts.test: pnpm --dir packages/shared build && pnpm --dir packages/game-engine build && vitest run --config vitest.config.ts
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --dir packages/shared build && pnpm --dir packages/game-engine build && tsc --noEmit -p apps/web/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/game-engine/tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json
scripts.format:check: prettier --check apps/web/app apps/web/lib apps/web/components packages/*/src packages/game-engine/tests tests eslint.config.mjs playwright.config.ts apps/extension apps/web/next.config.mjs
